title: I Let the Tool-Battery Gauge Catch the Member Who Returned Packs at One Bar

parts.text: I grabbed the labeled pack at 9:11 a.m. and the gauge sat on one bar. Member Glen had returned it as FULL since April. I was thirty-five, shop steward, holding a board that said RETURN AT GREEN. I photographed the gauge, the board, and Glen's name on the last checkout. Then I let the charger ping a low return. At 9:19 the desk asked Glen why the pack was one bar. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Glen now docks until green. Policy has a second line: FULL MEANS GREEN. I keep the photo. The wall finally looks like a gauge, not a rumor.

social.video_title: He returned my tool pack at one bar — Part 1/1
social.description: Return-at-green board, a one-bar gauge, an April habit. Would you have let the charger talk?
